name: chevron-down
description: A balanced downward chevron with straight arms and a rounded vertex.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Mirrored 45-degree arms meet at 12,15.25, with endpoints at 5.5,8.75 and 18.5,8.75. A single continuous centerline avoids doubled joins. Native bounds are centered at 12,12. Regular visible margins are 4.65 horizontally and 7.9 vertically. Rounded caps and the rounded lower vertex use the shared 1.70 stroke. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review. Owner requested visibly rounded arrow bends across all arrow-bearing icons. The old sharp V is replaced by a tangent circular centerline arc of radius1.50 centered at12 13.75, with straight tangent arms. Preserve the prior free endpoints, shaft, native visible bounds, centering and Regular1.70 weight. The visible outer bend radius is2.35 and inner bend radius .65; free caps remain .85. Filled is the exact analytical1.70 stroke band around this rounded head, unioned with its separate shaft where present. Transfer trays stay unchanged. This is actual centerline rounding, not only a round stroke join. Both styles remain drafts awaiting owner review.
